findings.issue: The proposal makes the durable map an authored synthesis, freshness-gated only “where derivable” and otherwise merely dated. Governing law explicitly says any map is a generated artifact, never hand-edited, with regenerate-and-diff CI. This is the same maintenance model that failed already: the dated DOCUMENTATION_MAP currently reports 16/10/7/13 files where the repository has 20/15/9/17 and contains four dead skill links.
findings.suggestion: Separate authored orientation guides from the generated map/index. Generate navigation, counts and links from section metadata; give each authored section declared source globs/specs/examples and invalidate its verification SHA when those inputs change. If the whole artifact must remain authored, amend ARCHITECTURE law 2 explicitly before landing this spec.

findings.issue: Maps are required to state “conventions an agent must follow,” while CONTEXT_CONTRACT assigns subtree conventions to nested AGENTS.md, makes docs reference material, and declares duplicated policy a defect. Consumers will either receive the rule twice or depend on a mandatory rule that is not in the deterministic entry payload.
findings.suggestion: Make Patterns contain canonical rule identifiers and pointers, plus observed example pointers—not restated normative conventions. Keep the operative rule in the owning AGENTS.md or skill.

findings.section: §1 Layer-A map; §5 JAuto homes; ARCHITECTURE law 3
findings.issue: The Layer-A map combines framework intent/specification with JAuto-specific spec-versus-implementation deltas and stores it under JAuto. That mixes framework-owned content and project adoption facts in files outside the contract’s small named set of composite-file exceptions.
findings.suggestion: Keep the portable Layer-A orientation source in justinventit, put JAuto implementation/adoption status in a project-owned overlay, and generate the composed navigation or comparison view.

findings.issue: The spec calls synthesis “thinking-tier work” but later assigns it to authoring-tier sessions. MODEL_MATRIX assigns docs_baseline to authoring and cross_review/diagnostic to thinking; those are distinct Claude models. Moreover, MODEL_MATRIX says the new tiers are not operative until its shipping PR lands and notes that the launcher still hardcodes two tiers.
findings.suggestion: Specify one executable mapping: section synthesis = docs_baseline/authoring, coherence and adversarial review = cross_review/thinking, collection = doing. Gate dispatch on the resolved-matrix rollout or state an explicit interim manual mapping.

findings.issue: A singular Sol fact-check plus periodic coherence review does not satisfy the matrix’s mandatory protocol for all judgment-review families: distinct-charter lenses, fresh independent validation of every surviving finding, schema verdicts and full-SHA grounding. “Lane e” is not a defined review lane; it is an ARCHITECTURE gate-lifecycle clause.
findings.suggestion: Reference review protocol v2 normatively, define separate fact and coherence charters, require a fresh refutation pass, and reserve runtime-behaviour claims for runner-backed evidence.

findings.issue: The planned packs cannot support the Layer-A deliverable. One justinventit pack covers specifications/template code, but no pack covers JAuto’s implemented agentic surfaces needed for the promised deltas: .claude has 229 tracked files, .agents 114 and scripts 153. The Layer-B list also repeats the old map’s command-surface omission: root commands route through scripts/ and simulation/, while Supabase Edge Functions are not named as a map subsystem.
findings.suggestion: Create paired Layer-A packs per component—portable specification/template plus JAuto implementation—and generate a coverage manifest from runtime entry points. Explicitly cover project tooling, simulation/local runtime, Edge Functions and deployment/integration surfaces.

findings.issue: The hierarchy stops at broad subsystem names without defining recursive decomposition or completeness. A single leaf cannot credibly cover six required dimensions for apps/web’s 1,175 tracked source files, 426 route/layout/page files and 464 components; test-data has 1,401 tracked files and migrations number 266. Authors must either violate the size contract or silently omit essential seams.
findings.suggestion: Define recursive child maps and a generated coverage inventory before synthesis—for example web domains, test-data layers and migration/schema/runtime subdivisions. Make 1–3KB apply to leaf sections, not entire subsystems, and pilot the decomposition on web before staffing the full set.

findings.issue: Versioned repomix config alone does not make a pack reproducible or fresh: source revision, tool version, invocation, config hash, output classification and numeric token ceiling are unspecified. The ambiguity is live: justinventit-role-P is 39 commits behind/1 ahead of the draft checkout and lacks ORIENTATION_MAPS.md; customer-portal-role-P is also divergent. “Has worktrees” therefore does not identify the source being packed, despite the lifecycle contract requiring sanctioned sync for persistent workspaces.
findings.suggestion: Dispatch exact workspaces, target branches and full SHAs; require the sanctioned sync/provision step; pin repomix in repo configuration; and emit a manifest containing source SHA, tool version, config hash and token count. Classify outputs as transient generated lenses—or track and freshness-gate them—and add deterministic rerun, exclusion/secret-scan and hard-budget acceptance tests.

strongest_aspect: The explicit NYI/aspiration surface, bidirectional initial verification and map-not-territory framing directly target real repository failure modes.
biggest_risk: These maps would become high-trust, first-read guidance whose semantic claims can silently stale—the old documentation rot amplified by making fresh sessions depend on it.
